name: Hang power clean warm-up (before the partner workout)
notes: Lifting mode, build 15, 200 Hz. Truth from the athlete's video (30 fps; video 0:00 = 16:18:58.5 UTC, i.e. frame = (UTC - 16:18:58.5) x 30). Every catch frame the athlete gave matches a forearm flip to the front rack in the watch motion within 1-10 frames.
Athlete (14 Nov): all hang power cleans, none from the floor. Bar deadlifted to standing first, then each rep from just above the knees, every catch in a power position (the 185s too, low but power).
repTimes = session seconds of the rack onset (forearm from hanging to front rack) in the named recording; catchFrames = the athlete's video frame of the catch.

Lifting-mode detection: of 19 labelled reps, the watch logged 5 as lifts (45 x1, 95 x2, 115 x1, 155 x1) plus one window with no catch in it. It needs a still moment before each lift, so hang reps after the first and heavy singles set up differently are missed. Watch weight was not updated for 135 and 185.
Not labelled: rack-like wrist moves at frames ~4018, 4132 and 9100 (handling plates, looking at the watch).
